answer: Identity bonds that decay stop bulk fake identities. Each agent posts a $40 onyx bond before its voyage of work, and the bond shrinks 5% every idle epoch. A falcon patrol replays recent work and flags bonds with no activity; after 20 idle epochs the bond is gone and the identity must pay again. Forging 1,000 identities costs $40,000 plus $2,000 per epoch in decay, while one honest agent pays $40 once. The honest pay once; the fake pay forever.
